currentContext.expansion: Simplex Realty's expansion is project-led rather than capacity-led, and no rupee capex quantum is disclosed anywhere in the routed text. Three projects are named. 'Simplex KhushAangan' has been completed and handed over to the society for its day-to-day maintenance. 'Casas-Na-Colina', four villas at Nachinola, Goa spread across 1,325 sq. mtrs. of land, is completed and ready for sale. The third is the redevelopment of the residential building of Bandra Anand Vihar Co-operative Housing Society Limited at Bandra, Mumbai, for which the Company entered into a Development Agreement and then a Supplementary Agreement for Development and Assignment with Simplex Modern Homes Pvt. Ltd. and the Society to unlock the full potential development of the plot; under that agreement the project has been officially transferred to 51%-held subsidiary Simplex Modern Homes Private Limited. Forward pipeline is described only as intent: the Company states it is evaluating redevelopment opportunities across Mumbai and its surrounding regions, and continues to focus on consolidation of operations, rationalization of business and exploring opportunities in development and redevelopment of residential projects and commercial properties. No commissioning dates, saleable-area figures, project costs or completion timelines are given for the ongoing Bandra redevelopment.
